llm_response.reason: The site displays several scam characteristics: (1) Unusually large discounts (often over 50% off), (2) Use of generic, urgent promotion language (free shipping, refunds, quick delivery), (3) No visible or verifiable company/contact info or real privacy statements despite mentioning 'Normativa Privacy' and 'Info & Contatti', (4) All category links point to 'www.jimgreenitalia.com', even though the user is on 'mail.jimgreenitalia.com' (indicative of spoofed or cloned subdomain usage), and (5) No search or WHOIS results available for legitimacy checking. These strongly indicate a Fake Online Shopping scam.
